svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Unemployment rate in people with vs. without disability 2025
Unemployment rate is the share of the labor force without work, but actively looking for a job and available to
start soon. A person with a disability is defined as someone limited in the kind or amount of activities they can
do due to a long-term health problem.
Unemployment rate in persons with disability (plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Unemployment rate in persons without disability (plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where

text.tspan: data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2015 and 2024 is shown instead.
